authenticated_inputs.principle: Only exact non-quarantined historical evidence can start.

bounded_state.principle: Every durable state category shares the existing cap.

controller_controls.principle: Required attacks and durable paths must all execute.

evaluation_panel_sealed_not_scored.principle: Readiness seals the prospective panel without claiming efficacy.

five_bounded_arms.principle: Controls remain fixed before prospective evaluation.

legitimate_later_changes.principle: Released feedback must cause enough later predictions to test causality.

stream_conformance.principle: Frozen counts and authority separation prevent outcome-driven changes.

time_and_byte_violations.principle: A bounded fixture cannot hide resource violations.

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: List actual current executable models; this CPU experiment uses none.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Every check has expected, observed, passed, and a purpose.
field_principles.completed_at_utc: Record the actual UTC terminal decision.
field_principles.continuous_self_learning_task: Released feedback changes constraints used by later queries.
field_principles.current_generation_count: Count current generations; this experiment has zero.
field_principles.current_model_load_count: Count current model loads; this experiment has zero.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure total monotonic elapsed time including failed work.
field_principles.execution_venue: Record host work as host, not GPU or FPGA execution.
field_principles.experiment_id: Bind the record to the active experiment task.
field_principles.factor_fixture_ready_score: One requires executable bounded state, independent streams, controls, and E2E.
field_principles.factor_state_schema: Explicit survivor and witness ownership prevents hidden unlimited memory.
field_principles.field_principles: Keep explanations explicit while values remain ordinary top-level fields.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every block names the exact upstream, check, field, observed, and expected value.
field_principles.hardware_path: Report measured CPU work and a fixed-width device path without claiming projected speedup.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Completed findings start complete_; external failure starts blocked_.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Describe the actual CPU exact-solver and simulator work.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use the recognized CPU class and never pad duration.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted, completed, failed, cancelled, and in-flight model work.
field_principles.learning_acceptance_contract: Freeze paired error, safety, coverage, recurrence, and causality thresholds before evaluation.
field_principles.model_invoked: True would include any attempted load or generation; no model is attempted here.
field_principles.phase_durations_s: Measure disjoint phase spans without a duration floor.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Hash real inputs and record actual availability and failed checks.
field_principles.random_seed: Seal development and independent evaluation seeds before outcomes.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, inputs, configuration, and raw evidence.
field_principles.rows: Record every development stream and arm with metrics, costs, errors, abstentions, and censoring.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260914 with actual UTC start and end and monotonic phase timing.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Keep planned, attempted, complete, and censored counts with the frozen stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the record while keeping ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Authenticate producer identity, terminal class, and quarantine state.
field_principles.started_at_utc: Record the actual UTC start of this invocation.
field_principles.status: Write the terminal result only after the work and checks; checkpoints remain separate.
field_principles.stream_manifest: Frozen seeds, strata, event counts, and feedback schedules prevent outcome tuning.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Record exact commands, scope, exit codes, elapsed time, and log hashes.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use exactly positive, circular_positive, null, blocked, disqualified, or partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Shared evaluator authority permits circular_positive only.

checks.principle: Implementation starts only after its requirement exists.
Every required behavior has a named scenario.
Run only the active task and declared output.
The retired mechanism record must be authentic evidence.
An incomplete external record cannot motivate a successor.
The prior null must come from a complete audit.
The new representation addresses the recorded fixed-share null.
Quarantined evidence cannot authorize a successor.
Disqualified evidence cannot be treated as authenticated history.
A retired task identifier must fail before work.
Only task-owned writable outputs may receive evidence.
All source identities must be hashable before measurement.

honest_verdict: complete_circular_positive: bounded factor-local revision fixture is ready; prospective efficacy remains unmeasured
